svg.title: Released baseline identity
svg.desc: An Operating Organization owns Logical Documents, each with Business Revisions and immutable Generations. Only a Generation manifest owns CPD ArtifactReferences; Product Structure and Format Intelligence may keep their own exact ArtifactId/digest pins in their metadata without becoming CPD ArtifactReferences. Generation manifests may pin Structure Snapshots. A Release Record pins exact Generations and approval evidence, plus zero or more exact Structure Pins only where its Release Policy selects or requires them, so later Working Heads cannot alter the released baseline.
